meaning: Evidence integrity and available provenance, not algorithm success or full paper reproduction
scope: 16 selected raw development representatives and 16 original GT controls; no resampling, training or 512-candidate evaluation
geometry_method: Shapely.affinity.rotate(use_radians=True) then translate; no runner geometry imported
summary_method: Shared aggregation formulas over independently checked geometry and independently recomputed comparisons; planned denominators additionally checked

repair_to_gap_effects.native_baseline_note: Native repair FP64 intermediate to final output; float32 final view includes its write conversion
repair_to_gap_effects.matched_precision_note: Repair intermediate and final output use the same precision, with no solver rerun

relative_to_native_repair.unit: one frozen selected prediction or GT through one path and output precision
relative_to_native_repair.denominator_note: Not a 512-candidate rate; failed supplied rows remain in all-planned fractions.
relative_to_native_repair.coverage_note: The runner must add failed rows for missing planned outputs and verify manifest coverage.
